- tests/test_review_apply_fixes_reviewer_manifest_validation.py
  Location: lines 98 and 116 (docstrings)
  Issue: The docstrings on `test_garbled_checksum_warns_but_passes` and `test_truncated_checksum_warns_but_passes` both reference "review run 35803994060" but 35803994060 is the PRIOR (completed) run used as the `PRIOR_REVIEW_RUN` exclusion filter in the companion Phase 4b tests (line 304, `head_sha=PRE_BAIT`, status `in_progress` in that fixture). The failing run the changelog and README both name is release gate run 35802596362. A future reader will hunt for the wrong run when chasing the incident this test exists to pin.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml
  Location: line 2349 (the new ADOPTED_REVIEW_RUN_ID lookup)
  Issue: The jq filter is `select(.head_sha == \"${BAIT_SHA}\" or .head_sha == \"${RETRY_DISPATCH_SHA}\")`. `BAIT_SHA` is propagated from `steps.inject-bait.outputs.bait_sha` (line 2056) without an in-script regex guard analogous to the `${RETRY_DISPATCH_SHA} =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$` check at line 2320. If the inject-bait step ever returns a non-hex value (corrupted output, schema change), the jq filter receives malformed input and the adopted-run lookup silently returns empty. `RETRY_DISPATCH_SHA` is already validated; `BAIT_SHA` should be too, for parity, since both are interpolated into the same jq program.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
